text_blocks.snippet: Long-term symptoms following COVID-19 vaccination are rare and typically mild, with the most common side effects being pain or swelling at the injection site. While some individuals have reported lingering or delayed symptoms, these are generally not considered long-term effects of the vaccine itself. A small subset of individuals experience what is referred to as Long Post-COVID Vaccination Syndrome (LPCVS), characterized by a range of neurological and other symptoms, but this is not a widely recognized or well-understood condition.
